## Q. How do I play a sound of my choice when an omikuji is displayed?

### Playing a preset sound

![](../../../../images/23_OmikujiEdit-1792765441161.webp)

- This feature is available in **Comment Events, Timer Events, and Action Sets alike**.
- You can set it when the action type in "**Omikuji Settings**" is **"Message"** or **"Sound"**.
  - All sounds used in the presets are **CC0-licensed** materials.
  - For sound licenses, see [License for sound effects and jingles](/core/OmikujiBot/sub/sounds.md).
- To check how a sound plays, press **"Test Sound"** in the preview on the left.

### Playing your own audio

- Put an mp3 or ogg file in assets/sounds.
- Manually enter the path of that file in (TODO:ファイルパスを入力する項目名を書く).
- If the sound plays with "Test Sound", you're done.
